review_iterations.summary: Functional check against upstream python-sdk v1.30.0 tests/client/test_notification_response.py (GitHub blob 7500abee736fa3874fc50fbe9b7da82146088f20): fixture contains three 127.0.0.1 usages (Uvicorn host, ephemeral port bind, client URL), all replaced with 127.0.0.3 by one exact-file substituteInPlace; readiness probe additionally receives host=127.0.0.3 through the earlier extended test helper. No mismatch between server and client address identified.

Regression review: preserves actual upstream test_non_compliant_notification_response and original ten-second readiness timeout; disabledTests still excludes only unrelated root-permission test; xdist remains disabled in MCP package. Nixer GitHub workflow 39311336063 on exact HEAD completed tests, Ruff, Nix evaluation and actual Nixer package check successfully. Direct host pytest tests/test_packaging.py cannot collect because host lacks Python mcp dependency (ModuleNotFoundError), not counted as PASS.

Security and provenance: modified host 127.0.0.3 is IPv4 loopback-only, not 0.0.0.0 or an external interface; only upstream package test file is modified, with --replace-fail anchors. Nixpkgs and MCP fetchPypi dependency identities remain pinned, no NixOS runtime or privileged/cache/trust-root changes, no tests disabled to mask fixture.

Integration review: source diff contains only flake.nix patch plus focused test_packaging regression; git diff --check clean; independent Nixer flake check --no-build succeeded (evaluation only). Downstream heim-pc PR228 remains separate exact Nixer-revision/NAR-pinned release, and production Review/Captain gates remain independent; this source self-review is not R3 or a merge grant.

residual_risk.reason: A dedicated loopback alias reduces competition with builders using 127.0.0.1 but cannot prove that 127.0.0.3 will never collide. Real exact-HEAD package CI succeeds; no change to test deadline or protocol assertions. Host pytest is dependency-incomplete and not counted as evidence.
